messages: Andrew is awake at home in Charleston, studying the word brilliant. His library holds 974 books.
Vesper now carries verified walkthroughs for 25 games, including GTA 6.
Last night Andrew dreamed 10 dreams, and 6 were painted before morning. His Dream Library holds 514 dreams across 39 nights.
Vesper is tested in the open. In the latest completed round, Round 151, she scored 2 of 5.
NeuroCore, our study of a learning brain built on a recurrent core, is in its first phase of testing.
Vesper is coming to Xbox. Her Xbox app is built, and we are waiting on Microsoft company verification, with an answer expected around December 1 and release expected in January.
